title: Kick-off — TechCore JP Data Platform

transcript.speaker: Tanaka Kenji (Client PM)
transcript.text: We expect daily written progress reports — not just Slack updates. Our previous vendor had no documentation and we lost track of progress.

transcript.speaker: Yamamoto Hiroshi (Client Tech Lead)
transcript.text: The existing Spark cluster is on EMR 6.2 and we cannot upgrade during the project. All new pipelines must be compatible.

transcript.speaker: Hung (Data Engineer)
transcript.text: Understood. We'll target EMR 6.2 compatible Spark 3.1 APIs throughout.

transcript.speaker: Tanaka Kenji (Client PM)
transcript.text: Security is critical — all data must stay in ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo). No cross-region replication.

title: Architecture Review — VinPay VN Payment Integration

transcript.speaker: Nguyen Van An (Client CTO)
transcript.text: Chúng tôi cần đảm bảo hệ thống xử lý được 10,000 giao dịch/phút vào giờ cao điểm. Đây là yêu cầu không thương lượng.

transcript.speaker: Tran Thi Lan (Client Tech Lead)
transcript.text: API của NAPAS có SLA 99.5% — khi họ downtime thì payment flow của chúng tôi phải gracefully fallback sang VNPAY. Vendor trước không xử lý được điều này.

transcript.speaker: Phuong (Tech Lead)
transcript.text: Chúng tôi sẽ thiết kế circuit breaker với fallback queue. Nếu NAPAS down, transaction được queue và retry tự động khi restore.

transcript.speaker: Nguyen Van An (Client CTO)
transcript.text: Tốt. Nhưng cần lưu ý: theo quy định NHNN, transaction data không được lưu quá 5 giây trên bộ nhớ trước khi flush xuống storage.

title: Sprint 5 Review — RetailEdge SG E-Commerce Platform

transcript.speaker: Jason Tan (Client Head of Digital)
transcript.text: The recommendation engine CTR is up to 3.1% — good progress, but still below the 4% target. We need the ML model to incorporate purchase history, not just browsing.

transcript.speaker: Wei Chen (Client Product Manager)
transcript.text: Also, the payment gateway timeout issue from last week — that was extremely damaging for us. We lost $12K in one afternoon. Can we get a post-mortem document?

transcript.speaker: Linh (PM)
transcript.text: The post-mortem is ready. Root cause was connection pool exhaustion. We've added circuit breaker and the staging tests show 99.7% success rate under peak load.

transcript.speaker: Jason Tan (Client Head of Digital)
transcript.text: Good. We also need to discuss the mobile checkout UX — 68% of our orders come from mobile but conversion is 40% lower than desktop. This needs to be the next sprint focus.

title: Discovery Call — MediCore KR Hospital Integration

transcript.speaker: Lee Sanghoon (Client IT Director)
transcript.text: 이 프로젝트의 핵심은 HIS와 EMR 시스템 간의 실시간 환자 데이터 동기화입니다. 현재는 수동으로 하는데 하루 3건 정도 오류가 발생합니다.

transcript.speaker: Kim Juhyun (Client Dev Manager)
transcript.text: 또한 의료법 제23조에 따라 환자 데이터는 국내 서버에만 저장해야 합니다. 해외 클라우드 서비스 사용이 불가합니다.

transcript.speaker: Nam (BA)
transcript.text: Understood. We will design the solution using domestic cloud providers. Can you share the existing HIS and EMR API documentation?

transcript.speaker: Lee Sanghoon (Client IT Director)
transcript.text: 문서가 불완전합니다. 이전 SI업체도 같은 문제로 고생했습니다. 개발 기간 중 저희 팀과 긴밀히 협업해야 할 것 같습니다.

title: UAT Sign-off Meeting — ShopViet Multi-Vendor Platform

transcript.speaker: Le Van Minh (Client CEO)
transcript.text: Vendor management module có một bug nhỏ — khi vendor upload ảnh >5MB hệ thống không báo lỗi rõ ràng. Cần fix trước go-live.

transcript.speaker: Nguyen Thi Hoa (Client Product Lead)
transcript.text: Ngoài ra, tôi muốn xác nhận lại: code ownership hoàn toàn về phía ShopViet sau khi bàn giao, kể cả database schema và deployment scripts.

transcript.speaker: Phuong (PM)
transcript.text: Đúng — tất cả source code, scripts, và documentation đều được bàn giao. Không có IP nào giữ lại.

transcript.speaker: Le Van Minh (Client CEO)
transcript.text: Tốt. Chúng tôi đã bị vendor cũ giữ source code khi kết thúc hợp đồng — đó là lý do chúng tôi rất coi trọng điều này.

title: Technical Deep Dive — PayFlow JP ISMS Certification

transcript.speaker: Yamada Takeshi (Client Security Lead)
transcript.text: ISO 27001認証が必須です。認証書の写しと、直近の内部監査報告書を提供できますか？

transcript.speaker: Ito Ryota (Client CTO)
transcript.text: また、開発環境のソースコード管理ポリシーも確認したいです。以前のベンダーは本番データを開発環境に使用していたことが判明しました。

transcript.speaker: Trung (Solution Architect)
transcript.text: We strictly separate production data from non-production environments. All dev/staging environments use fully anonymized or synthetic data.

transcript.speaker: Yamada Takeshi (Client Security Lead)
transcript.text: ペネトレーションテストは年1回実施していますか？報告書をNDAの下で共有してもらえますか？

title: Contract Negotiation — InsurVN Data Residency

transcript.speaker: Pham Duc Anh (Client VPTech)
transcript.text: Câu hỏi cuối cùng về data residency: server phải đặt ở đâu? AWS ap-southeast-1 là Singapore — không đáp ứng được yêu cầu của chúng tôi.

transcript.speaker: Hoang Thi Mai (Client Legal)
transcript.text: Cục Quản lý Giám sát Bảo hiểm yêu cầu rõ ràng: dữ liệu bảo hiểm phải ở Việt Nam. Đây là nghĩa vụ pháp lý, không phải tùy chọn.

transcript.speaker: Sales (Account Manager)
transcript.text: We are exploring partnership with Viettel IDC and FPT Telecom data centers for VN-based hosting. Can you give us 2 weeks to confirm feasibility?

transcript.speaker: Pham Duc Anh (Client VPTech)
transcript.text: 2 tuần được. Nhưng nếu không khả thi về mặt kỹ thuật hoặc chi phí, chúng tôi sẽ phải xem xét lại toàn bộ hợp đồng.

title: Sprint Planning — MedViet Patient App

transcript.speaker: Le Van Khanh (Client CTO)
transcript.text: Tính năng đăng nhập cần hỗ trợ thẻ BHYT để tự động điền thông tin. API của Cục Quản lý Khám chữa bệnh có sẵn nhưng không ổn định — đôi khi timeout 30 giây.

transcript.speaker: Nguyen Bao Tran (Client Product Manager)
transcript.text: Cũng cần lưu ý: 40% bệnh nhân của chúng tôi là người cao tuổi. UX cần cực kỳ đơn giản — chữ to, icon rõ ràng, giảm thiểu số bước.

transcript.speaker: Huy (Tech Lead)
transcript.text: Understood. We'll design with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and a minimum font size of 18px for all patient-facing screens.

transcript.speaker: Le Van Khanh (Client CTO)
transcript.text: Security question: khi bác sĩ truy cập hồ sơ bệnh nhân, hành động đó có được log lại đầy đủ không? Đây là yêu cầu của Bộ Y tế.

title: Escalation Call — AnalyticsAI IN Spark OOM

transcript.speaker: Arjun Patel (Client Engineering Director)
transcript.text: This is unacceptable. We have 3 enterprise clients waiting for their monthly reports and we can't process the data. Every hour of delay costs us client trust.

transcript.speaker: Hung (Data Engineer)
transcript.text: We've identified the root cause — 40% of data belongs to one customer due to a partition skew issue. We need to repartition on a salted key. ETA for the fix is 4 hours.

transcript.speaker: Priya Ramesh (Client Data Lead)
transcript.text: 4 hours is okay for today, but this should not happen again. We need a permanent fix and a monitoring alert before this threshold is hit.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Patel (Client Engineering Director)
transcript.text: Also, I want a formal SLA review next week. If this kind of issue recurs, we'll need to re-evaluate the engagement.

title: Pre-Sales Call — EduKorea AI Learning Platform

transcript.speaker: Yoon Soyeon (Client CPO)
transcript.text: AI 학습 경로 추천 엔진의 정확도가 최소 85%는 돼야 합니다. 교육부 인증을 받으려면 이 기준을 충족해야 하거든요.

transcript.speaker: Park Minsu (Client Tech Lead)
transcript.text: 학생 데이터는 개인정보보호법에 따라 국내에만 저장해야 합니다. AWS 서울 리전 사용은 괜찮습니다.

transcript.speaker: Nam (BA)
transcript.text: Can you share the curriculum data structure? For the recommendation engine to work well, we need at minimum 6 months of student interaction history.

transcript.speaker: Yoon Soyeon (Client CPO)
transcript.text: 네, 공유해 드릴게요. 그런데 모델 설명 가능성도 중요합니다. 학부모와 교사가 왜 특정 학습 경로가 추천됐는지 이해할 수 있어야 해요.

title: Commercial Review — RetailChain JP SLA Terms

transcript.speaker: Ito Kenji (Client Procurement)
transcript.text: SLA 99.9%は必須条件です。これを下回った場合のペナルティは月額契約費の2%/時間を要求しています。

transcript.speaker: Nakamura Sato (Client Legal)
transcript.text: 前回のベンダーで¥15Mの損失が出たため、このペナルティ条項は譲れません。リスクの共有が必要です。

transcript.speaker: Sales (Account Executive)
transcript.text: We can accept the 99.9% SLA but the penalty rate of 2%/hour is too high. We propose a cap at 10% of monthly contract value total, with a 15-minute grace period per incident.

transcript.speaker: Ito Kenji (Client Procurement)
transcript.text: キャップには同意できますが、グレースピリオドは5分を主張します。確認して回答します。

title: Technical Discovery — FinKorea KR Banking API

transcript.speaker: Shin Woojin (Client CEO)
transcript.text: 한국 KEB하나, 신한, 국민은행 API 연동 경험이 있으신가요? Open Banking Korea 플랫폼 작업도 포함됩니다.

transcript.speaker: Kim Gyehyun (Client CTO)
transcript.text: 금융보안원 인증도 필요할 수 있어요. 이 부분 도움받을 수 있을까요?

transcript.speaker: Khanh (Solution Architect)
transcript.text: We have experience with Open Banking Korea API and can guide through the FSRDC certification process. Our security team has worked on similar fintech compliance requirements.

transcript.speaker: Shin Woojin (Client CEO)
transcript.text: 좋습니다. 한 가지 더 — 한국에 로컬 팀이 있으신가요? 급한 이슈 발생 시 같은 시간대 커뮤니케이션이 중요해서요.

title: Incident Post-Mortem — FinTrack MY Fraud Detection

transcript.speaker: Ahmad Zulkifli (Client CTO)
transcript.text: 12 transactions slipped through fraud detection because of the Kafka consumer lag. Our board meeting is tomorrow and I need a clear explanation of root cause and prevention.

transcript.speaker: Long (Backend Engineer)
transcript.text: Root cause: consumer group rebalancing triggered by a new consumer joining took 8 minutes — during which no messages were consumed. We've implemented sticky partition assignment to prevent this.

transcript.speaker: Siti Rahayu (Client Head of Risk)
transcript.text: We need an automated alert when consumer lag exceeds 100 messages. This cannot happen silently again. What is your monitoring coverage currently?

transcript.speaker: Ahmad Zulkifli (Client CTO)
transcript.text: And we need a formal commitment that this class of issue will not recur. I'll need to present this to my board with guarantees.

title: Onboarding Review — DataDriven UK ML Team

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson (Client CDO)
transcript.text: Two things are non-negotiable: all data processing must be in EU jurisdiction, and we need GDPR data subject request workflows built in from day one, not retrofitted.

transcript.speaker: Emma Clarke (Client Data Science Lead)
transcript.text: Also, our recommendation engine must be explainable — we get regulatory scrutiny on automated decisions affecting users. Black box models are not acceptable.

transcript.speaker: Tuan (ML Engineer)
transcript.text: We'll use SHAP values for feature importance and build an explanation layer into the API response. This is standard in our ML delivery process.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson (Client CDO)
transcript.text: Good. One more thing — our legal team reviewed GDPR and requires a Data Processing Agreement signed before any data is shared with our team. Can you expedite this?

title: Budget Review — LogiCorp TH WMS Phase 2

transcript.speaker: Napat Srisuk (Client Finance Director)
transcript.text: Our FY2026 budget for technology was cut by 20%. We still want the full WMS integration but need to spread payments over 8 months instead of 5.

transcript.speaker: Somchai Wattanaporn (Client IT Director)
transcript.text: The integration with the 3 legacy warehouse systems is the critical path. If we must descope, barcode scanner support can wait for Phase 3.

transcript.speaker: Sales (Account Manager)
transcript.text: We can accommodate phased billing. However, a 8-month timeline will require scope to be clearly prioritized. Can we agree on Phase 2 MVP scope before the next meeting?

transcript.speaker: Somchai Wattanaporn (Client IT Director)
transcript.text: Yes. Priority is: real-time WMS sync, inventory accuracy reporting, and SAP integration. Barcode and mobile app can be Phase 3.

title: Sprint 8 Review — HRCloud PH Payroll

transcript.speaker: Carlo Reyes (Client Head of Finance)
transcript.text: The BIR Form 2316 issue is causing us serious problems. Two of our enterprise clients have already submitted incorrect forms. We need this fixed and a correction process for already-submitted forms.

transcript.speaker: Maria Santos (Client CEO)
transcript.text: Also, can you explain what happened? How did the tax bracket logic get deployed incorrectly? We need to understand the QA gap.

transcript.speaker: Hoa (FE Engineer)
transcript.text: The TRAIN Act 2025 update changed bracket thresholds effective January 2026 but our tax table was not updated. We've added a compliance test suite that validates against BIR published tables on every release.

transcript.speaker: Carlo Reyes (Client Head of Finance)
transcript.text: Good. We need retroactive correction reports for all affected employees going back to January. This is urgent.

title: Security Review — MedSoft US HIPAA Architecture

transcript.speaker: Rachel Kim (Client CISO)
transcript.text: HIPAA requires that all PHI at rest be encrypted with FIPS 140-2 validated algorithms. KMS with AWS managed keys is acceptable but we prefer CMK with automatic rotation.

transcript.speaker: Eric Johnson (Client Engineering Manager)
transcript.text: Also, we need a BAA (Business Associate Agreement) signed before any PHI touches our systems. Our legal team has already prepared it.

transcript.speaker: Rachel Kim (Client CISO)
transcript.text: One more requirement: all API calls accessing PHI must have a user identity logged in CloudTrail. Service-to-service calls must use IAM roles, never long-lived credentials.

transcript.speaker: Khanh (Solution Architect)
transcript.text: All of these are standard in our HIPAA deployment checklist. We'll also implement VPC endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB to keep PHI off public internet even internally.

title: Proposal Presentation — LogiKorea KR Tracking System

transcript.speaker: Jung Daewon (Client CIO)
transcript.text: 레거시 시스템이 3개 있고 각각 다른 DB를 씁니다 (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL). 이 세 시스템의 데이터를 실시간으로 통합해야 합니다.

transcript.speaker: Kwak Minjun (Client System Architect)
transcript.text: 기존 시스템을 수정할 수 없어요. CDC (Change Data Capture) 방식으로만 접근해야 합니다.

transcript.speaker: Phuong (Solution Architect)
transcript.text: We recommend Debezium for CDC on all three databases with Kafka as the integration backbone. This approach requires zero changes to existing systems.

transcript.speaker: Jung Daewon (Client CIO)
transcript.text: 이전 벤더는 CDC를 모른다고 했고 결국 배치 방식으로 제안했는데 우리 요건에 맞지 않았습니다. Debezium 경험이 있는 엔지니어 CV를 보내주시겠어요?

title: Churn Risk — EduTech VN Post-Mortem

transcript.speaker: Tran Van Hieu (Client CTO)
transcript.text: Chúng tôi đã quyết định không gia hạn. Latency 800ms cho live coding là không chấp nhận được — sinh viên phàn nàn liên tục.

transcript.speaker: Delivery Manager
transcript.text: We understand. To be clear about root cause: the latency is primarily due to container cold start in our current architecture. We were working on edge deployment but didn't complete it in time.

transcript.speaker: Tran Van Hieu (Client CTO)
transcript.text: Vendor mới của chúng tôi có infrastructure với POP tại Hà Nội và TP.HCM. Latency của họ là 120ms. Đây là sự khác biệt quá lớn.

transcript.speaker: Delivery Manager
transcript.text: Understood. We appreciate your transparency. Is there anything we could have done differently that would have changed the outcome?

title: Competitive Demo — FintechCo ID OJK Compliance

transcript.speaker: Rizal Hakim (Client Product Director)
transcript.text: We are evaluating 3 vendors. Our main selection criteria: OJK P2P lending compliance experience, credit scoring explainability, and track record with Indonesian fintech regulations.

transcript.speaker: Budi Pranoto (Client CTO)
transcript.text: The OJK sandbox has very strict rate limits — 10 req/min in sandbox. We had a bad experience with a vendor who didn't test properly and caused a sandbox suspension.

transcript.speaker: Nam (Solution Architect)
transcript.text: We've built 2 OJK P2P-compliant systems before. Our approach: we build the OJK sandbox integration as a separate module with its own rate limiter and circuit breaker, isolated from production flow.

transcript.speaker: Rizal Hakim (Client Product Director)
transcript.text: Good. One question about credit scoring: we need to document the model's decision factors for each applicant, as required by OJK. How do you approach model explainability for regulators?
